answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch opens 100 slots; applicants bid a deposit, and the highest bids win. An agent monitoring tundra sensors pays one 50-coin bid, recovers it after 20 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards. A sybil farmer cannot wander in with 1,000 clones: each must outbid applicants, locking 50,000 coins for 20 epochs, more than copies earn. Open crystal records expose reused bids, which forfeit their deposit.
